payload.text:
Escalation to the owner.
1. Question: may the audit export include message bodies by default, or must bodies stay opt-in?
2. Task: the export task ({{task}}), attempt {{attempt}}, blocked at the header contract.
3. Attempted resolution: task record (silent on the default); design document section 'Communication logs and improvement evidence' (metadata-only default); PR 82 review comment (asks for bodies by default for analysis). Peer and coordinator have no further evidence.
4. Evidence: refs below.
5. Options: (a) keep metadata-only default per the design, add include_bodies opt-in: no design change, analysis passes the flag; (b) bodies by default: contradicts the design and widens exposure of message text in every export.
6. Impact: the export header contract and its test wait; the attempt stays BLOCKED; if undecided by the next working day the attempt is declined and the task returns to READY with this note.
7. Exact pending request: owner decision between (a) and (b); (a) recommended.

refs.ref: docs/DESIGN-agent-teams.md 'Communication logs and improvement evidence' at the recorded base commit: message content is opt-in, metadata-only exports are the default

refs.note: review comment asking for bodies by default
